newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian stocks edge up in light volumes.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian stocks edge up in light volumes.

text.p: Lithuanian shares moved up a notch in very light trade on Thursday, as overall volume of the central market fell to 54,060 litas against the last session's 158,317 litas on December 31.
The group A index, which tracks the central market's 35 most active listings, rose by 45.96 points to 1,706.65.
Birzai Milk dairy remained unchanged at 8.2 litas in trade of 24,682 litas.
Lithuanian Gas edged up to 1.4 litas from 1.3 in turnover of 5,600 litas.
Ukio bank gained to 19.10 litas against 19.01 in trade worth 14,516 litas.
No deals were registered on Thursday in block trading or the secondary market of government Treasury bills.
